snippet.title: Tower Command - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Tower Command
A roguelike tower defense with high level of strategy and tactics. Build towers to maximize bonuses and synergies to stop the endless horde of demons, beasts and undead. Unlock new commanders and upgrades, employ endless strategies to reach as far as you can.

Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3719660/Tower_Command/

Follow the development of Tower Command on X: 
https://x.com/rile_games

Credits:
Trailer music: saurabh-chaudhary
